target.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "controller_runtime_event")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "text")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "text"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "text", "run_id", "event_id"])
  |> group()
